title: Understanding Islam and sharing Christ with Muslim friends
tagline: Listen first, learn what Muslims believe in their own words, and then speak about Jesus with clarity and love.
whyItMatters: Muslims are about a quarter of the world and many are our neighbours and friends. The Church asks us to respect them and also to bear witness to Christ.

mindset.tip: Listen before you speak. Ask what your friend believes and why (1 Peter 3:15-16: give a reason with gentleness and reverence).
Start from what the Church says: she looks on Muslims with esteem because they adore the one God (Nostra Aetate 3; CCC 841).
Hear Muslims in their own words: read the Qur'an in translation and Muslim writers before you answer them.
Do not argue to win. Name real agreements (one God, prayer, almsgiving, Mary, Jesus as a prophet) and real differences (Trinity, Incarnation, Cross) calmly.
Know the history, including the Crusades, but never use it as a weapon or an excuse.
